sources.title: Three Partition Refinement Algorithms
sources.enterprise_use: Provides direct prior art for efficient partition refinement and coarsest-partition computation. P023 uses simple finite refinement only as established infrastructure and does not claim Paige-Tarjan algorithmic novelty.
sources.not_claimed: Partition refinement, coarsest stable partitions, and Paige-Tarjan algorithms are established prior work.
